description: Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::AIWorkloadConfig. A reusable AI workload configuration that defines datasets, data sources and benchmark tool settings for consistent performance testing of generative AI inference deployments on Amazon SageMaker AI.

AIDatasetConfig.description: The dataset configuration for an AI workload.

InputDataConfig.description: An array of input data channel configurations for the workload.

AIWorkloadInputDataConfig.description: A channel of input data for an AI workload configuration.

ChannelName.description: The logical name for the data channel.

DataSource.description: The data source for this channel.

AIWorkloadDataSource.description: The data source for an AI workload input data channel.

S3DataSource.description: The Amazon S3 data source configuration.

AIWorkloadS3DataSource.description: The Amazon S3 data source for an AI workload.

S3Uri.description: The Amazon S3 URI of the data.

AIWorkloadConfigs.description: The benchmark tool configuration for an AI workload.

WorkloadSpec.description: The workload specification that defines benchmark parameters.
The workload specification for benchmark tool configuration.

Inline.description: An inline YAML or JSON string that defines benchmark parameters. The service validates the document against its own benchmark schema: it must declare a benchmark object whose type member matches the pattern ^(aiperf)$.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The tag key. Tag keys must be unique per resource.

AIWorkloadConfigName.description: The name of the AI workload configuration. The name must be unique within your AWS account in the current AWS Region. Only lowercase letters and digits are accepted: DeleteAIWorkloadConfig lowercases the name before looking it up, so a name containing an uppercase letter produces a configuration that can be created and read but never deleted.

AIWorkloadConfigArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AI workload configuration. The name segment is restricted to lowercase for the same reason as AIWorkloadConfigName: the engine derives that property from this ARN, so a permissive ARN would yield a derived name the schema itself rejects.

DatasetConfig.description: The dataset configuration for the workload. Specify input data channels with their data sources for benchmark workloads.

AIWorkloadConfigs.description: The benchmark tool configuration and workload specification.

CreationTime.description: A timestamp that indicates when the AI workload configuration was created.

Tags.description: The metadata that you apply to the AI workload configuration to help you categorize and organize it.
